question: ________ was considered as the most important part of some of the earliest Hindu temples.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Garbhagriha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Garbhagriha means "womb chamber" or "sanctum sanctorum".**
 
• Garbhagriha is considered the most important part of some of the earliest Hindu temples because it houses the main deity of the temple.
